verified: Google Research's blog post and the underlying ICML 2025 paper (arXiv 2502.06785) both state that DeepCrossAttention — depth-wise cross-attention over the residual stream — reaches the same model quality up to 3x faster while adding a negligible number of parameters, and improves perplexity for a given training time; the blog also reports that retrofitting DCA onto a pre-trained transformer and briefly continuing training cut LM1B perplexity by 0.19 versus 0.02 for continued standard training.
unconfirmed: the "up to 3x" figure is a best-case result from Google's own language-modeling experiments (LM1B-scale, per the paper) and has not been independently reproduced or shown to hold at frontier scale; the reported parameter overhead, perplexity gains and speedups are the authors' measurements rather than third-party benchmarks, and no released model, code availability or production deployment is confirmed.

verified: Google Research 的博客与 arXiv 论文（ICML 2025）报告，DeepCrossAttention 通过改造 transformer 残差连接、在层间做深度交叉注意力，在 LM1B 语言建模实验中达到同等质量最多快 3 倍，新增参数量可忽略。
unconfirmed: 上述加速与质量结论仅来自 Google 自己的论文实验，尚无独立复现或第三方基准；现有公开摘要未说明代码或模型权重是否及何时开放，也未界定可迁移到哪些现有模型。
